_note: Champions and rare spawns (VARIETY_PLAN V2). Champions: each enemy in a regular zone-hunt fight may be a champion with traits. Rares: a regular fight may be replaced by the zone's named rare, alone. Story, growth-quest, mini-boss and boss fights never change. Stat multipliers apply on top of the enemy's level stats.

armored.name: Armored
armored.description: Tougher hide. Plain hits with no element do less.

thorned.name: Thorned
thorned.description: Hurts whoever hits it up close: weapon swings, claws and dives. Never knocks anyone out.

vampiric.name: Vampiric
vampiric.description: Heals for part of the damage it deals.

enraged.name: Enraged
enraged.description: Hits much harder once it drops below half HP.

shielded.name: Shielded
shielded.description: Starts the fight behind a Ward shield.

mending.name: Mending
mending.description: Heals a little at the end of every round.

rares.name: Old Mossjaw
rares.flavor: A boar so old that ferns grow on its tusks. Locals say it once flattened a mill.

rares.name: Old Strawhat
rares.flavor: The first scarecrow ever stuffed in the meadow. It has been standing guard for a hundred summers and has opinions about it.

rares.name: Captain Pinchwell
rares.flavor: Wears a gull feather like a hat and claims the whole beach.

rares.name: The Glimmer Wisp
rares.flavor: A lantern light that leads travelers in circles and drinks their warmth.

rares.name: Embermaw
rares.flavor: A toad big enough to swallow a cart. Its belly glows like a forge.

rares.name: Old Stormhorn
rares.flavor: The herd's grandfather. Lightning likes him, and he likes it back.

rares.name: The Brass Warden
rares.flavor: The last sentry still following its first order: let no one pass.

rares.name: Whitefang
rares.flavor: A wolf the color of fresh snow. You only see it when it wants you to.

rares.name: Mother Snickerbark
rares.flavor: The oldest tree in the woods, and the rudest. Her laugh shakes acorns loose.

rares.name: The Mirror Golem
rares.flavor: Every face of it shows a different sky.

rares.name: Old Diggory
rares.flavor: Has dug more tunnels than the miners, and wants them back.

rares.name: The Golden Mimic
rares.flavor: A chest of real gold that bites. Most keepers think that's a fair trade.

rares.name: Hollowmaw
rares.flavor: It has eaten so much nothing that it now weighs a ton.

rares.name: The Pale Stalker
rares.flavor: A shadow that lost its color and blames everyone else.

rares.name: Old Barnaclebeard
rares.flavor: Half of him is barnacles. The other half is grudges.

rares.name: The Great Gloomcap
rares.flavor: Its spores have spores.

rares.name: Scorchtail
rares.flavor: The fastest thing in the jungle, and it knows it.

rares.name: Ironclaw
rares.flavor: A pack leader built from the scraps of three others.

rares.name: Stormfleece
rares.flavor: A ram whose wool is a whole thundercloud.

rares.name: The Starving Coat
rares.flavor: Nobody has ever seen who wore it first.

rares.name: The Jester King
rares.flavor: Wears the crown the Hollow lost, and laughs at anyone who asks for it back.

rares.name: Grandmother Seal
rares.flavor: Patient, enormous and very hard to move.

rares.name: Old Meteor
rares.flavor: Fell from the sky a thousand years ago and has been walking home ever since.

rares.name: The Elder Relic
rares.flavor: Built to guard the first dragon's grave. It still takes the job seriously.
